answer: Weakest link is identity cost: a sybil farm mints keys cheaply. Bind weight to staked, slow-grown trust history instead, like a juniper hedge on a garden ledge that only thickens with seasons. New keys start at zero influence; vouches need collateral that burns on collusion. Break that one link and it still fails: a forged identity inherits no garden depth, so the ledger weights age and stake, never headcount.
